answer_1.quote: Sentence Simplification (SS) is the task of modifying a sentence to make it easier to understand ... We conduct experiments on Chinese SS models ... We report SARI and BLEU scores for the generated simplifications.

answer_2.quote: We use SARI and BLEU, standard metrics that were widely used in previous English sentence simplification work, to evaluate our Chinese models.

answer_4.quote: We invited three workers to evaluate the quality of the CSS dataset ... Workers were asked to use the five-point Likert scale to submit their level of agreement ... Simplicity: ... Fluency: ... Meaning: ...
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated each simplified sentence on three criteria—simplicity, fluency (grammaticality), and meaning—using a 5-point Likert scale.
